page.overview:
Who is E'Sar G'Go B'Kul?

E'Sar G'Go B'Kul was the leader of the Gorothite resistance group T'B'Dellyi'Mai. Young, arrogant and aggressive, he had a innate talent for devising insurrection and terrorist tactics. E'Sar G'Go B'Kul hated all offworlders.
